title: One-finger tendon study
scope: Constant-radius sector and spool envelopes, not groove/anchor/spring or fabrication-ready finger geometry.
notes: Tip force is perpendicular to the 30 mm arm; other contact directions change the moment.
Tendon remains tangent to the 10 mm circular sector at y=10; anchored wrap must cover the whole 60 degree excursion.
Clevis cheeks z=-4.3..-0.3 and 8.3..12.3, finger z=0..8; nominal side clearance 0.3 mm each, calibrated before fabrication.
